nodes.rationale: This is a rendered Nepali Laal Purja (land ownership certificate) issued by the Government of Nepal, Ministry of Land Reform and Management, Department of Land Reform and Management, Land Revenue Office Saaku (साखु), Kathmandu. Certificate No. NM0000095. The document is bilingual (Nepali/English). It records land ownership for Uma Devi Chaulagain (उमा देवी चौलागाईं), address: District Kathmandu M.C./V.D.C. Nakulbhare (नाकुलेभारे), Ward No. 8. Husband: Hemkant Chaulagain (हेमकान्त चौलागाईं). Father-in-law: Deurushi Chaulagain (देउरुषी चौलागाईं). Citizenship No. 10005, Issued Date 2049/03/09, Issued Office: District Administration Office, Kathmandu. Three land parcel entries are listed (Prior Plot Nos. 444, 682, 642), all in District/VDC Kathmandu/Nakulbhare, Ward 6 (Awadi/house) and Ward 8 (raiker niji/cultivated), Plot Nos. 448, 619, 642, all single-owner (एकलौटी), tenant Hira Lal Chaulagain (हिरा लाल चौलागाईं), land class Bhit/Pakho/Bari/Doim (भिट/पाखो/बारी / दोयम). Areas: 2-9-0-0 Ropani + 8380.08 sq.m.; 3-14-1-0 Ropani + 2011.02 sq.m.; 2-2-0-0 Ropani + 8068.06 sq.m. Total Area 4332.09 sq.m. Print Date: 2062/08/18 A.D.
